executive_summary: Autonomous vehicle commercialization accelerated as Uber launched Europe’s first fully driverless robotaxi service in Croatia and Tesla initiated Cybercab operations in Texas. Simultaneously, Texas began real-world air taxi flights under a new federal program, while Joby Aviation completed its first NYC eVTOL flights. Geopolitical tensions disrupted global energy infrastructure, with drone strikes on Saudi oil pipelines causing price surges, and Russia proposed high-speed rail technology to India during BRICS discussions.
what_to_watch: Uber has launched Europe’s first truly driverless robotaxi service in Croatia, operating with zero human safety drivers and utilizing Chinese software, marking a significant milestone in autonomous vehicle deployment.

Texas has initiated real-world air taxi flights under a new federal program, with TxDOT confirming that air taxis are beginning to take flight in the state this fall, signaling progress in eVTOL integration.

Russia has proposed building its Ivolga FG high-speed trains (capable of 360 km/h) in India, a development discussed during the sidelines of BRICS, indicating potential shifts in international rail infrastructure partnerships.

Top Developments.title: Uber is now running Europe’s first truly driverless robotaxis—with zero human safety drivers
Top Developments.summary: Uber has commenced operations of Europe’s first fully driverless robotaxi service in Croatia, featuring zero human safety drivers and powered by Chinese software. This development coincides with broader regulatory movements, such as Virginia lawmakers advancing self-driving vehicle regulations and global self-driving rules entering the real world. Additionally, Waymo is exploring battery reuse for the Texas grid, and Lucid and Uber are planning to bring robotaxis to Houston. The Volkswagen ID. Buzz robotaxi is also hitting LA streets, highlighting a surge in autonomous vehicle commercialization.

Top Developments.title: War in Ukraine: International outcry after Russian drone strikes train near border with Poland
Top Developments.summary: Russian drone strikes have hit a train near the Polish border and a power engineer in Sumy Oblast, causing international outcry. Houthi claims of strikes on Saudi Arabia have led to oil surges past $107 and threats to global oil supply. Trump has called on Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel sites amid a global shortage. These events highlight the vulnerability of transportation and energy infrastructure to geopolitical conflicts. Additionally, Iran-US tensions are escalating with Houthi claims of drone attacks on Saudi bases.

Top Developments.title: TxDOT: Air taxis begin taking flight in Texas this fall
Top Developments.summary: Texas has started real-world air taxi flights under a new federal program, with TxDOT confirming that air taxis are taking flight this fall. Joby Aviation has also completed its first NYC eVTOL flights from JFK to Manhattan in 7 minutes. While developers in Japan are stepping up commercialization efforts, the sector faces challenges, including significant capital burn with zero passengers carried in some cases and the need for new airport infrastructure. Archer Aviation's stock performance and future outlook are also under scrutiny.

Top Developments.title: Sweden's Freya Industries raises $620K seed to scale drone detection across Europe
Top Developments.summary: Sweden’s Freya Industries has raised $620K to scale drone detection across Europe, while Poland has unveiled the MAKO X1 man-portable counter-UAS system. DroneShield is expanding its open counter-drone architecture and integrating with AIM Defence’s high-power laser system. Leonardo has signed a contract with Kongsberg for counter-UAS systems. In the US, Punjab Police is deploying new drone detection platforms to combat cross-border drug smuggling. NATO scrambled jets in Lithuania after a false drone detection, highlighting the sensitivity of airspace security. Moog demonstrated a RIwP turret on an autonomous vessel, and a tier-1 defense partnership is advancing armored vehicle counter-UAS integration.
